Bank telegraphic transfer — documented China salary verified route

Convert lawful after-tax China salary with source/tax evidence and remit by SWIFT to your own US account. BOC tariff is the published cost example.

Published components: BOC current tariff effective 2025-11-11: cross-border TT commission 0.1% of remittance amount, minimum CNY 50, maximum CNY 260 per transaction; TT cable CNY 150 outside HK/Macao/TW or CNY 80 to those regions; overseas bank charges actual. Conditional USD full-arrival service: USD 15 if receiving bank has a BOC New York account, otherwise USD 25, only for eligible indirect routing. Fee currency conversion uses BOC's transaction-time buying rate if collected in FX.

Formula: commission_CNY = min(max(0.001 * gross_remittance_CNY_equivalent, 50), 260); cable_CNY = 150 (international) or 80 (HK/Macao/TW); all_in_USD = FX_friction + fees_USD + routing_USD + tax_USD + preparation_USD

Blank numeric USD cells are unverified and flagged; they are not zero. Flag register · Procedure

Bank telegraphic transfer — unused RMB from an earlier exchange verified route

Reconvert unused RMB using the original exchange memo within 24 months, or qualifying foreign-card RMB withdrawal evidence within six months at ICBC.

Published components: BOC current tariff effective 2025-11-11: cross-border TT commission 0.1% of remittance amount, minimum CNY 50, maximum CNY 260 per transaction; TT cable CNY 150 outside HK/Macao/TW or CNY 80 to those regions; overseas bank charges actual. Conditional USD full-arrival service: USD 15 if receiving bank has a BOC New York account, otherwise USD 25, only for eligible indirect routing. Fee currency conversion uses BOC's transaction-time buying rate if collected in FX.

Formula: commission_CNY = min(max(0.001 * gross_remittance_CNY_equivalent, 50), 260); cable_CNY = 150 (international) or 80 (HK/Macao/TW); all_in_USD = FX_friction + fees_USD + routing_USD + tax_USD + preparation_USD

Conditional USD full-arrival service: USD 15 if receiving bank has a BOC New York account, otherwise USD 25, only for eligible indirect routing. Fee currency conversion uses BOC's transaction-time buying rate if collected in FX.

Formula: commission_CNY = min(max(0.001 * gross_remittance_CNY_equivalent, 50), 260); cable_CNY = 150 (international) or 80 (HK/Macao/TW); all_in_USD = FX_friction + fees_USD + routing_USD + tax_USD + preparation_USD

Bank telegraphic transfer — foreign currency already in a mainland FX account supporting only

Remit USD already held in a mainland foreign-currency savings account. This is not a CNY conversion route, but it is the second leg after a lawful purchase.

Published components: BOC current tariff effective 2025-11-11: cross-border TT commission 0.1% of remittance amount, minimum CNY 50, maximum CNY 260 per transaction; TT cable CNY 150 outside HK/Macao/TW or CNY 80 to those regions; overseas bank charges actual. Conditional USD full-arrival service: USD 15 if receiving bank has a BOC New York account, otherwise USD 25, only for eligible indirect routing. Fee currency conversion uses BOC's transaction-time buying rate if collected in FX.

Formula: commission_CNY = min(max(0.001 * gross_remittance_CNY_equivalent, 50), 260); cable_CNY = 150 (international) or 80 (HK/Macao/TW); all_in_USD = FX_friction + fees_USD + routing_USD + tax_USD + preparation_USD

Foreign-invested enterprise dividend to a foreign individual conditional

Distribute genuine FIE profits to a foreign individual with corporate approvals and withholding. From 2026-09-01 the former foreign-individual exemption is repealed and 20% PRC IIT applies.

Published components: From 2026-09-01, foreign-individual FIE dividends: 20% PRC IIT withholding under announcement 2026 No. 27, subject to separately established treaty entitlement. Bank/FX fees unverified. The 20% applies to dividend income, not automatically to the USD transfer target.

Formula: PRC_withholding_CNY = 0.20 * taxable_dividend_CNY (if no treaty reduction); all_in_USD unknown; US tax/FTC separate

Lawful current-account RMB remittance, then offshore conversion conditional

Remit RMB for a genuine current-account purpose under bank due diligence, then convert offshore if the receiving bank accepts RMB. This is not blanket capital-account permission.

Published components: PBOC current-account RMB policy verified; domestic remittance fee, offshore RMB acceptance/conversion spread and receiving fees are unverified.

Formula: all_in_USD = RMB_remittance_fee + offshore_conversion_friction + receiving_fee + tax_USD; compare against direct CNY-to-USD quote

Overseas ATM withdrawal with a mainland card verified route

Withdraw local cash abroad using a mainland card, subject to SAFE's per-person annual and per-card daily caps. Unsuitable for large balances.

Published components: SAFE cap: CNY 100,000 equivalent/person/calendar year across all domestic cards; CNY 10,000/card/day. BOC current international debit: 0.5% of withdrawal, min USD 3/max USD 5 per withdrawal; ordinary debit: CNY 12 + 1%, max CNY 112. Foreign ATM surcharge may apply. Announced change effective 2026-11-11: UnionPay CNY 12 + 1% max CNY 112; Visa/MC 2.5% min USD 3/max USD 40.

Formula: fee_per_withdrawal = min(max(0.005 * withdrawal_USD, 3), 5) for current BOC international debit; total unknown because withdrawal count/rates/caps apply
